findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop waste water to still be present within mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mop water was disposed of. Ensure mop waste water is disposed of nightly into the mop sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.113 Storing Maintenance Tools. Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in waste water in mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, mop was relocated to a hanging position. Ensure after use mo is placed in a position to air dry while preventing any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
